Implemented [Dashboard](/workspace/app/Dashboard.tsx) to fetch analytics, notifications, and settings concurrently with `Promise.all`, following the page’s existing data-fetching pattern. It displays each response under its own heading and shows an error message if a request fails.

TypeScript and the production build pass. This repository has no handlers for those three API routes, so displaying live data depends on those endpoints being available.
